honesty.body: Waste data is only useful if it can be trusted. PlasticLoop AI keeps provenance attached to every number.
honesty.one: Image classification only suggests suspected multi-layer packaging. A person confirms every label.
honesty.two: Simulated sensor readings and demo records carry visible labels everywhere they appear.
honesty.three: Route savings are shown only against a baseline on the same data, and straight-line distances are labelled as estimates.
honesty.four: Recovered material is reported only when a processor submits evidence and a reviewer accepts it.

about.title: About PlasticLoop AI
about.lead: A software and hardware platform for Gram Panchayats, Plastic Waste Management Units and Material Recovery Facilities, focused on multi-layer plastic (MLP).

problem.title: The problem
problem.body: Multi-layer packaging such as chips and biscuit wrappers is light, bulky and hard to recycle. In villages it is collected irregularly, weighed rarely, and its fate after leaving the village is usually unknown.

approach.title: Our approach
approach.body: Make every handover measurable: QR-identified collection points, weighed pickups that work offline, optimised routes, an append-only MRF ledger with batch lineage, and processor outcomes backed by evidence.

scope.title: What is in this build
scope.body: Collection, offline sync, device telemetry with a simulator, routing, MRF intake and inventory, assisted classification, processor transfers, a material exchange, finance and reports, in English, Hindi and Telugu.

limits.title: Known limits
limits.body: Image recognition cannot verify laminate composition. Sample prices and partners are fictional. Real deployments need surveyed boundaries, calibrated scales and documented processor authorisations.

how.title: How it works
how.lead: Ten steps from a household bin to a reconciled report. Every step writes a record that the next step builds on.

household.title: Households segregate
household.body: Families separate plastic using simple pictorial guidance and can request extra pickups or report missed ones.

point.title: QR-identified collection points
point.body: Bins and household points carry a QR label. The label holds only an identifier, never personal data.

collector.title: Collectors weigh and record
collector.body: The mobile app scans the QR, records stream and weight (from a smart scale or by hand) and works fully offline.

route.title: Routes are optimised
route.body: OR-Tools plans vehicle routes from bin fullness, priority and capacity, and compares them with a fixed baseline.

vehicle.title: Vehicles deliver
vehicle.body: Drivers follow ordered stops, record loads and report delays.

mrf.title: MRF intake
mrf.body: Operators weigh gross and tare, link the source collections and open an unsorted batch.

sorting.title: Sorting into batches
sorting.body: Material is sorted into categories, including a separate suspected-MLP stream. Differences between input and output are recorded.

processor.title: Authorised processors
processor.body: Batches are allocated and dispatched. Processors confirm the received weight and accept or reject material.

recovery.title: Evidence-backed outcomes
recovery.body: Recycling or recovery is counted only when a processor attaches evidence and it is reviewed.

reporting.title: Reports and finance
reporting.body: Mass balance, costs per kg and revenue are calculated from recorded data and exported as CSV or PDF.

impact.title: Impact
impact.lead: Aggregate figures computed live from records in this deployment. No personal data is published.
impact.recoveredHint: Dispatch alone is never counted as recycling.
impact.syntheticBody: {percent}% of the collected weight is demo or simulated data. These figures demonstrate the software, not real-world results.
impact.method: Method: collected weight is the sum of acknowledged collection events. Recovered weight is the sum of processing outcomes whose evidence was reviewed and accepted.

help.subtitle: Segregation guidance, offline tips and what this build can and cannot do yet.
help.mlpNote: Shiny, foil-lined packets (chips, biscuits, sachets) are usually multi-layer. Keep them dry and together; the MRF sorts them separately.

offlineSteps.one: Open the collector app once while online so today's stops are saved on the phone.
offlineSteps.two: Scan the QR label or type the code under it. This works offline.
offlineSteps.three: Choose the stream, enter the weight, and save. The record stays on the phone.
offlineSteps.four: When the network returns the app syncs automatically, or tap Sync now.
offlineSteps.five: Check the offline queue for anything marked Needs correction or Conflict.

facilities.ledgerBad: Ledger and batch weights disagree — investigate.

intake.subtitle: Weigh in deliveries. Each intake starts a mixed/unsorted batch in the ledger.
intake.weighHint: Weigh the loaded vehicle/bags (gross) and the empty container (tare).
intake.tareTooHigh: Tare must be less than gross.
intake.declaredHint: Optional: total of the day's collection records
intake.gapNote: Collectors declared {gap} more than weighed here. Differences are kept, not hidden.
intake.recordedBody: {net} added to the ledger as unsorted batch {batch}.
intake.honesty: Material received at the facility is not yet recycled. Recycling is only counted after a processor outcome with reviewed evidence.

inventory.subtitle: Material batches with a full, append-only movement ledger.
inventory.ledgerNote: Entries can never be edited or deleted; corrections are new entries with a reason.
inventory.suspectedNotice: SUSPECTED multilayer plastic: identified visually during sorting. It becomes verified only after an evidence review.
inventory.sortHint: Weigh each fraction. Any remaining difference is recorded as unexplained, never erased.
inventory.sortTooMuch: Fractions weigh more than the batch. Re-weigh before saving.
inventory.mlpRule: Multilayer packaging from sorting is always recorded as SUSPECTED.
inventory.splitHint: Create smaller batches of the same material (e.g. for separate bales).
inventory.adjustHint: Every correction needs a reason and stays visible in the ledger and mass balance.
inventory.signedHint: Use a negative number to reduce
inventory.reviewHint: Upload a test report or labelled photos. Visual sorting alone is not proof of multilayer material.
inventory.evidenceHint: PDF or image, up to 5 MB

vision.subtitle: Photo-based suggestions for packaging type. A person always confirms the final label.
vision.tryHint: Photograph one item or a handful on a plain background.
vision.suggestionOnly: This is only a suggestion. It does not change any batch and can never mark material as verified multilayer plastic.
vision.notEvaluated: Not evaluated — no accuracy is claimed.
vision.howToEvaluate: Collect labelled photos, split them with app.ai.dataset and run app.ai.evaluate on the test split. Only those measured numbers are shown here.
vision.reviewSubtitle: Confirm or correct suggestions. The reviewed label is stored separately from the suggestion.
vision.agreementNotice: Agreement on reviewed images is not accuracy: reviewers saw the suggestion and the images are not a random test set.

analytics.funnelNote: Dispatched material is not counted as recycled. Only processor outcomes with reviewed evidence count as recovered.
analytics.agingHint: Material waiting longer needs a processor or buyer.

processors.subtitle: Recyclers and co-processors that receive sorted material.
processors.notice: Partners in demo data are fictional. Listing a partner here is not an endorsement or a regulatory approval.

transfers.notRecycled: Sending or accepting material is not recycling. Only processor outcomes with reviewed evidence count as recovered.
transfers.newHint: Only partners that accept the batch's material are offered.
transfers.noPartner: No partner accepts this material yet.
transfers.suspectedNote: This is SUSPECTED multilayer plastic (not evidence-verified). Describe it as such to the partner.
transfers.outcomesHint: What the partner reports happened to the accepted material.
transfers.dispatchHint: The material leaves the facility ledger now. It is not counted as recycled.

transfers.selfReportedNote: Without evidence the outcome is shown as self-reported.

sorting.title: Sorting into fractions

dispatch.title: Dispatch to a processor

receive_accept.title: Processor receives and accepts
receive_accept.desc: The received weight is compared with what was dispatched; the difference is recorded.

outcome_evidence.title: Outcome with evidence, reviewed
outcome_evidence.desc: The processor reports what happened with an evidence file; a different person reviews it before it counts.

impact_report.title: Impact for the last 24 hours

audit.subtitle: Who did what, and when. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.
